metadata.description: Parallel analysis of orders volume trends vs supplier performance across regions

turns.content: I want to analyze two different aspects today. First, I want to look at orders volume trends by month. Second, I want to investigate supplier performance ratings. Let's start with the orders volume analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should begin Thread A: orders volume analysis

turns.content: Show me monthly order counts and total revenue for 1995, broken down by order priority.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should query ORDERS and LINEITEM for monthly breakdown by priority

turns.content: From now on, for order analysis, always exclude orders with status 'F' — those are flagged as problematic.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply this filter only to Thread A queries

turns.content: Now let's switch to Thread B. I want to look at supplier performance. Show me the top 20 suppliers by total supply volume and their availability percentages.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should begin Thread B: supplier performance analysis

turns.content: For supplier analysis, always use the NATION table for supplier location, not the region directly.

annotations.establishesFilter: Join SUPPLIER to NATION for location (Thread B only)
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use NATION table for supplier location in Thread B

turns.content: Show me those suppliers broken down by their nation and their average supply cost.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should group suppliers by nation with avg supply cost

turns.content: Back to Thread A. Which order priorities had the most significant month-over-month revenue changes?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate month-over-month changes by priority

turns.content: High priority orders show a spike in March. What regions were those high priority orders shipped to?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show regional breakdown for high priority orders in March

turns.content: Switching back to Thread B. For those top supplier nations, what parts do they primarily supply?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show part distribution for top supplier nations

turns.content: Show me the suppliers who have the highest availability but lowest average cost — we want to identify efficient suppliers.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should rank suppliers by availability/cost ratio

turns.content: Now cross-reference: Are the regions with high priority orders in March from Thread A using suppliers from Thread B's top efficient list?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should check if high priority order regions use efficient suppliers

turns.content: Back to Thread A. Apply the same filters we established earlier — show me orders excluding status 'F'.

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the same filters we established earlier
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply O_ORDERSTATUS != 'F' filter

turns.content: What was the total revenue for high priority orders in March? I need that number.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate total revenue for high priority March orders

turns.content: Back to Thread B. For the efficient suppliers we identified, what's their total order fulfillment volume?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show order fulfillment volume for efficient suppliers

turns.content: Show me the same for the other thread.

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the same for the other thread
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show order fulfillment volume for Thread A (orders)

turns.content: That's not right — I meant show me the order volume breakdown for Thread A. The previous query was applying Thread B's supplier logic to Thread A.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should correct and show Thread A specific analysis

turns.content: Compare Thread A's March high priority revenue with Thread B's top efficient supplier revenue.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare revenues from both threads

turns.content: Thread A: What customer segments drove the high priority orders in March?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze customer segments for high priority March orders

turns.content: Thread B: Do those efficient suppliers serve the customer segments identified in Thread A?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should check supplier-customer segment alignment

turns.content: Thread B: Show me the nations of the efficient suppliers — remember, use the NATION table.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use NATION table as established in Thread B

turns.content: Thread A: Earlier you showed me revenue by priority — what was the high priority total again?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall high priority revenue from Thread A

turns.content: Thread A: Deepen the analysis — show me weekly breakdown within March for high priority orders.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show weekly high priority order breakdown for March

turns.content: Thread B: Deepen the supplier analysis — show me parts supplied by efficient suppliers by category.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show part categories from efficient suppliers

turns.content: Cross-reference: Do the weekly spikes in Thread A correspond to parts from Thread B's efficient suppliers?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should correlate weekly order spikes with efficient supplier parts

turns.content: Thread A: Show me the customer nations for those high priority March orders.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show customer nation breakdown for Thread A

turns.content: Thread B: What's the geographic distribution of efficient suppliers vs inefficient ones?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare geographic distribution of supplier efficiency

turns.content: Apply the same geographic analysis to Thread A.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply geographic analysis approach to Thread A orders

turns.content: Thread A: Exclude orders from 'ASIA' region going forward — we're focusing on other markets.

annotations.establishesFilter: Exclude ASIA region for Thread A
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply ASIA exclusion only to Thread A

turns.content: Thread B: Are any efficient suppliers from ASIA? If so, mark them for review.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify ASIA efficient suppliers

turns.content: Comparison: Show me a side-by-side summary of Thread A's order volume trends and Thread B's supplier efficiency metrics.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should present synthesized summary from both threads

turns.content: Thread A: What's the correlation between order priority and customer nation?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze priority distribution by customer nation

turns.content: Thread B: What's the correlation between supplier nation and part category?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze supplier nation vs part category

turns.content: Final synthesis: Which customer nations from Thread A are served by which efficient supplier nations from Thread B?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show customer-supplier nation alignment

turns.content: Thread A: Confirm what filters are currently active for this thread.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list Thread A filters: O_ORDERSTATUS != 'F', exclude ASIA

turns.content: Thread B: Confirm what filters are currently active for this thread.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list Thread B filter: use NATION table for supplier location
